summary: The purpose of this report is to recommend to City Council the appointment of a Deputy City Manager.
decided: City Council on June 14 and 15, 2023, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint Will Johnston to the position of Deputy City Manager for the City of Toronto, with such appointment to be effective on June 16, 2023, subject to written acceptance by the candidate, of the terms and conditions of a contract of employment offered by the City. 2. City Council authorize the City Manager to negotiate terms and conditions of employment with Will Johnston. 3. City Council authorize the public release of the name and curriculum vitae summary of Will Johnston in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (June 7, 2023) from the City Manager upon City Council's approval of the appointment.
